column3: Suspicious Comments: false positive. Matches the word 'select' in the minified React bundle (JSX <select> and a library URL comment), not a developer comment.
Modern Web Application: informational. Tells ZAP to use the Ajax spider (the workflow passes -j).
Unexpected Content-Type: only '/' remains, which is the HTML dashboard itself and correctly text/html. Soft-404 regressions are covered by apps/api/test/security.test.ts.
Content Cacheability: informational. API responses are deliberately Cache-Control: no-store (live data); static assets are fingerprinted and cached for a year.
